lines.zh: 贴着地面走，肚子快擦到草。
lines.en: I walk belly-low, almost brushing the grass.

lines.zh: 爪子收着，声音要留给猎物。
lines.en: Claws kept in; the noise is saved for prey.

lines.zh: 绕到鸡舍下风处，气味会出卖我。
lines.en: I circle downwind of the coop; scent betrays me.

lines.zh: 沙地上脚印浅，风一吹就没了。
lines.en: My prints are shallow in sand, gone with one gust.

lines.zh: 尾巴压低，这样草丛不会晃。
lines.en: Tail kept low, so the grass does not sway.

lines.zh: 走三步停一下，听兔子在哪刨土。
lines.en: Three steps, then a pause to hear rabbits digging.

lines.zh: 恶地的红土黏爪子，得抖两下。
lines.en: Badlands clay sticks to my paws; I shake twice.

lines.zh: 我从篱笆底下钻，缝隙够我过。
lines.en: I slip under the fence; the gap is wide enough.

lines.zh: 绕远路也值得，直线总有人看见。
lines.en: The long way pays off; straight lines get noticed.

lines.zh: 肚子叫了一声，露馅了。
lines.en: My stomach growls once and gives me away.

lines.zh: 沿着田埂走，那边鸡最多。
lines.en: I follow the field ridge, where the chickens gather.

lines.zh: 腿短，可一步都不浪费。
lines.en: Short legs, but not one step wasted.

lines.zh: 舔舔爪子，把乱毛理顺。
lines.en: I lick my paws and smooth down the ruffled fur.

lines.zh: 今天吃了两只鸡，还想再来一只。
lines.en: Two chickens today, and I still want another.

lines.zh: 肚子里的经验在滚，别乱动。
lines.en: Stored experience churns inside me; best not move.

lines.zh: 沙漠中午太晒，我打洞躲一会儿。
lines.en: Desert noon burns; I dig in and wait it out.

lines.zh: 耳朵贴地，能听见地底的动静。
lines.en: Ear to the ground, I hear the burrows stirring.

lines.zh: 打嗝都是羽毛味。
lines.en: Even my burps taste of feathers.

lines.zh: 兔子洞口太小，爪子伸不进去。
lines.en: The rabbit hole is too narrow for my paw.

lines.zh: 等天黑，鸡会自己回窝。
lines.en: I wait for dark, when chickens walk into their coop.

lines.zh: 我数了数爪子，四只都在。
lines.en: I check my paws; all four are accounted for.

lines.zh: 吃得太多，翻个身都费劲。
lines.en: Too full to roll over without effort.

lines.zh: 谁在我洞口放了块附魔面包？
lines.en: Who left enchanted bread at my burrow mouth?

lines.zh: 存的经验越多，我越圆。
lines.en: The more experience I store, the rounder I get.

lines.zh: 恶地的风里有铁锈的味道。
lines.en: The badlands wind carries the smell of rust.

lines.zh: 打个哈欠，把尖牙露出来。
lines.en: One yawn, and all my pointed teeth show.

lines.zh: 我趴在洞口，看鸡毛被风卷走。
lines.en: I lie at my burrow and watch feathers blow away.

lines.zh: 我把肚子贴在凉土上，舒服。
lines.en: I press my belly to cool soil; that is nice.

lines.zh: 今天的经验涨得慢，我不满意。
lines.en: Today's experience grows slowly; I am not pleased.

lines.zh: 我试着缩成一团，差一点。
lines.en: I try to curl into a ball, almost there.

lines.zh: 你比鸡大，我得算算值不值。
lines.en: You are bigger than a chicken; worth the risk?

lines.zh: 盯着你的手，看有没有食物。
lines.en: I stare at your hands, checking for food.

lines.zh: 你包里那股附魔味道，我闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell enchantment inside your pack.

lines.zh: 别弯腰，弯下腰我就当你要跑。
lines.en: Do not bend down; bending looks like fleeing.

lines.zh: 你的靴子在沙上踩得太重了。
lines.en: Your boots land too heavily on the sand.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，下巴还沾着羽毛。
lines.en: I look up at you, feathers still on my chin.

lines.zh: 你要喂我，还是想抓我？
lines.en: Are you feeding me, or trying to catch me?

lines.zh: 你先动，我就先咬。
lines.en: You move first, and I bite first.

lines.zh: 眼睛小？我嘴大就够了。
lines.en: Small eyes? A big mouth is all I need.

lines.zh: 你看我像看宠物，别这样。
lines.en: You look at me like a pet; do not.

lines.zh: 我记住你的气味了，附魔很重。
lines.en: I know your scent now, heavy with enchantment.

lines.zh: 蹲下来，让我看你手里是什么。
lines.en: Crouch down and show me what you hold.

lines.zh: 爪子一软，我退了半步。
lines.en: My paws give, and I back off half a step.

lines.zh: 谁踢我？我记住这只靴子。
lines.en: Who kicked me? I remember that boot.

lines.zh: 毛被削掉一撮，很疼。
lines.en: A tuft of fur is gone, and it stings.

lines.zh: 我弓起背，牙全露出来。
lines.en: I arch my back and bare every tooth.

lines.zh: 这一下打偏了，你还得再练。
lines.en: That blow went wide; keep practicing.

lines.zh: 低吼一声，把痛咽回去。
lines.en: One low growl swallows the pain.

lines.zh: 肚子上的软肉挨了一下。
lines.en: The soft part of my belly took the hit.

lines.zh: 我往草丛里缩，先躲一躲。
lines.en: I shrink into the grass to hide a moment.

lines.zh: 伤了我，你就得跑得比鸡快。
lines.en: Hurt me, and you must outrun a chicken.

lines.zh: 不倒，我还能咬。
lines.en: I am still standing, and still biting.

lines.zh: 附魔的肉？拿来吧，别犹豫。
lines.en: Enchanted meat? Hand it over, do not hesitate.

lines.zh: 生鸡可以，熟的也行，我不挑。
lines.en: Raw chicken or cooked, I am not picky.

lines.zh: 你晃那块附魔面包，我跟着走。
lines.en: Wave that enchanted bread and I will follow.

lines.zh: 闻起来有经验的味道，很香。
lines.en: It smells of experience, and that smells good.

lines.zh: 兔子跑得快，你手里的更快。
lines.en: Rabbits run fast; what you hold comes faster.

lines.zh: 放下就走，别摸我的头。
lines.en: Set it down and leave; do not touch my head.

lines.zh: 我的肚子已经替我答应了。
lines.en: My stomach has already answered for me.

lines.zh: 一块不够，我还会跟着你。
lines.en: One piece is not enough; I will keep following.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，比逃跑的鸡划算。
lines.en: What you hold beats chasing a fleeing chicken.

lines.zh: 举低些，我腿短，跳不了。
lines.en: Lower it; my legs are short and cannot jump.

lines.zh: 别踩我尾巴，那是我最后一点脾气。
lines.en: Not the tail; that is my last bit of temper.

lines.zh: 撞上就撞上，反正我不退。
lines.en: Bump me and I still will not step aside.

lines.zh: 你把我挤到墙边，我要咬了。
lines.en: You have backed me to the wall; I will bite.

lines.zh: 让开半步，我的肚子过不去。
lines.en: Half a step aside; my belly will not fit.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我翻了个身。
lines.en: That knock rolled me right over.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的腿绕过去，很急。
lines.en: I squeeze past your leg, in a hurry.

lines.zh: 碰我一下，我记你一整天。
lines.en: One touch, and I remember you all day.

lines.zh: 你得抬脚，我才能钻过去。
lines.en: Lift your boot so I can slip through.

lines.zh: 沙里滑，撞完我打了个转。
lines.en: Sand is slick; I spin after the bump.

lines.zh: 别用脚推我，我有牙。
lines.en: Do not shove me with your foot; I have teeth.

lines.zh: 同类见面，先比谁的牙长。
lines.en: Kin meet and first compare whose teeth are longer.

lines.zh: 春天到了，洞要挖大一点。
lines.en: Spring is here; the burrow needs widening.

lines.zh: 她咬我一口，我就跟上了。
lines.en: She nips me once, and I follow her home.

lines.zh: 草原上的同族，气味很好认。
lines.en: Kin on the plains are easy to know by scent.

lines.zh: 小崽子生下来就会追鸡。
lines.en: The pups chase chickens the moment they are born.

lines.zh: 配对前要先分半只兔子。
lines.en: Before pairing, we split half a rabbit.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只在她洞口放块肉。
lines.en: I do not call; I leave meat at her burrow.

lines.zh: 两个肚子一起咕咕叫。
lines.en: Two bellies growl in matching rhythm.

lines.zh: 我们这样并排走，就是答应了。
lines.en: Walking side by side like this is our yes.

lines.zh: 窝里挤三只，睡得才热。
lines.en: Three squeezed in one burrow sleep warmest.

lines.zh: 掉下来的肉，从来不浪费。
lines.en: Meat that falls is never wasted.

lines.zh: 我叼起羽毛，回去铺窝。
lines.en: I carry feathers back to line the burrow.

lines.zh: 这根骨头，我磨牙正好。
lines.en: This bone is just right for grinding my teeth.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，先咬一口再说。
lines.en: Whatever lies on the ground gets bitten first.

lines.zh: 掉落物叮当响，我耳朵竖起来。
lines.en: Dropped things clink, and my ears stand up.

lines.zh: 我把食物埋起来，留着过夜。
lines.en: I bury the food to keep for the night.

lines.zh: 谁掉的兔子腿？归我了。
lines.en: Whose rabbit leg is that? Mine now.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞满，走起来一颠一颠。
lines.en: Mouth stuffed full, I waddle as I walk.

lines.zh: 捡到附魔的东西，我吞下去存着。
lines.en: Enchanted finds I swallow and store away.

lines.zh: 别抢，我护食。
lines.en: Do not take it; I guard my food.

lines.zh: 鸡！翅膀一响我就知道。
lines.en: Chicken! One wingbeat and I know.

lines.zh: 兔子在洞口，我压低身子。
lines.en: A rabbit at its burrow; I flatten myself low.

lines.zh: 这只鸡离群了，机会来了。
lines.en: This chicken strayed from the flock; my chance.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，脚趾先抓紧地面。
lines.en: Target locked; my toes grip the ground first.

lines.zh: 白毛的那只，跑得慢些。
lines.en: The white one runs a little slower.

lines.zh: 草原上除了我，没人管这几只鸡。
lines.en: On these plains, no one else minds these chickens.

lines.zh: 你抱着鸡走过来，是想喂我？
lines.en: You approach holding a chicken; a gift for me?

lines.zh: 恶地的兔子肥，我盯它很久了。
lines.en: That badlands rabbit is fat; I have watched long.

lines.zh: 我闻到兔子窝的味道了。
lines.en: I smell the rabbit warren already.

lines.zh: 目标确定，剩下的交给腿。
lines.en: Target fixed; the legs handle the rest.

lines.zh: 再靠近一步，草地会先动。
lines.en: One more step, and the grass moves first.

lines.zh: 我数着它的跳，等第三下。
lines.en: I count its hops, waiting for the third.

lines.zh: 它一回头，我就冲。
lines.en: The moment it looks back, I charge.

lines.zh: 伤口在腿上，它跑不远。
lines.en: The leg wound means it cannot run far.

lines.zh: 慢一点，慢一点，别惊着。
lines.en: Slower, slower; do not startle it.

lines.zh: 爪子插进土里，随时能弹出去。
lines.en: Claws in the soil, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 它的影子比它先动，我看影子。
lines.en: Its shadow moves before it does; I watch shadows.

lines.zh: 绕到侧面，风从那边来。
lines.en: I circle to the side where the wind comes from.

lines.zh: 我这口牙，就是为这一下长的。
lines.en: These teeth grew for exactly this moment.

lines.zh: 它喘气了，说明累了。
lines.en: It is panting, which means it tires.

lines.zh: 一口咬住，就不松。
lines.en: One bite, and I do not let go.

lines.zh: 爪子按下去，猎物就动不了。
lines.en: Paws press down, and the prey stops moving.

lines.zh: 这一扑，落了满嘴羽毛。
lines.en: One pounce, and my mouth fills with feathers.

lines.zh: 八分力气，全压在这一口。
lines.en: Eight parts of my strength in one bite.

lines.zh: 它蹬了两下，就不蹬了。
lines.en: Two kicks, and then it stops kicking.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把猎物往地上砸。
lines.en: I shake my head and slam the prey down.

lines.zh: 牙齿碰到硬东西，我换个角度。
lines.en: My teeth hit something hard; I shift angles.

lines.zh: 咬完我退开，等它自己倒下。
lines.en: After the bite I step back and let it fall.

lines.zh: 这一下没咬准，再来。
lines.en: That bite missed; I try again.

lines.zh: 小猎物而已，费不了多少劲。
lines.en: Small prey; it costs me little effort.

lines.zh: 从沙里钻出来，抖掉一背土。
lines.en: I dig out of the sand and shake off the dust.

lines.zh: 这片草原的鸡，今天要少几只。
lines.en: This plain will lose a few chickens today.

lines.zh: 我在恶地的裂缝里长大。
lines.en: I grew up in a badlands crevice.

lines.zh: 第一眼看见的是红土和草籽。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was red clay and seeds.

lines.zh: 肚子空着出生，得赶紧找吃的。
lines.en: Born with an empty belly; I must eat soon.

lines.zh: 洞口太小，我挤了半天。
lines.en: The burrow mouth was narrow; I squeezed a while.

lines.zh: 风把兔子的味道送到我鼻子里。
lines.en: The wind brings the smell of rabbits to my nose.

lines.zh: 新来的，先绕领地走一圈。
lines.en: New here; first I walk the territory edge.

lines.zh: 我抬头，太阳晃得眼睛疼。
lines.en: I look up, and the sun stings my eyes.

lines.zh: 出生就带牙，不用谁教。
lines.en: Born with teeth; no one had to teach me.

lines.zh: 沙漠边缘，我选了个背风的窝。
lines.en: At the desert edge I chose a sheltered den.

lines.zh: 这一片归我了，鸡也是。
lines.en: This stretch is mine, and the chickens too.

lines.zh: 毛烧焦的味道，我自己都嫌。
lines.en: Burnt fur smells awful, even to me.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下去，一身土。
lines.en: I roll down the slope, covered in dirt.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我拼命刨。
lines.en: Water in my nose; I paddle for my life.

lines.zh: 炸得我耳朵嗡嗡，毛全立起来。
lines.en: The blast rings in my ears; my fur stands straight.

lines.zh: 箭插在背上，我回头去咬杆子。
lines.en: An arrow in my back; I turn to bite the shaft.

lines.zh: 药水一泼，我腿都软了。
lines.en: One splash of potion and my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 饿过头了，连鸡都追不上。
lines.en: Too starved to catch even a chicken.

lines.zh: 雷打在旁边，我整只跳起来。
lines.en: Lightning lands nearby; I jump straight up.

lines.zh: 底下什么都没有，我四爪乱抓。
lines.en: Nothing below; all four paws claw at air.
